say:3:1521403001:0.text: The witch doctors are taking so long to check everyone. When's my turn?
say:3:1521403001:0.source_cn: 巫祭们检查得好慢，什么时候才能到我？

say:4:1521403002:0.text: They ask your name, birthday... a few weird questions. Then they check your body.
say:4:1521403002:0.source_cn: 他们要问名字，问生日，唔，问几个奇怪的问题……然后才是...

say:6:1521403004:1.text: I dunno. My mom said that's just how it works.
say:6:1521403004:1.source_cn: 我也不知道，是我阿娘说的。

say:7:1521403005:1.text: She came to one of these when she was little. I wonder if she got picked.
say:7:1521403005:1.source_cn: 她小时候也来选过祭品，不知道她有没有选上。

say:8:1521403006:0.text: Dummy! If she had, she wouldn't be your mom!
say:8:1521403006:0.source_cn: 笨！她就是没选上才成了你阿娘！

say:9:1521403007:0.text: Why do you think our parents insist we come? If you're chosen, you don't live at home anymore.
say:9:1521403007:0.source_cn: 你们说，为什么阿爹阿娘一定要让我们来选祭品？当祭品就不...

say:10:1521403008:0.text: You don't get it. Being chosen is an honor. You get to serve the Hunting God!
say:10:1521403008:0.source_cn: 你懂什么？当祭品是一种荣耀，可以侍奉狩猎神！
say:10:1521403008:0.male: You don't get it. Being chosen is an honor. You get to serve the Hunting God!
say:10:1521403008:0.female: You don't get it. Being chosen is an honor. You get to serve the Hunting Goddess!

say:11:1521403009:0.text: But warriors serve the god too, right? My dad's hunting party always brings the best game as an offering.
say:11:1521403009:0.source_cn: 战士不也在侍奉狩猎神吗？我阿爹的狩猎队每次打猎回来，都...
say:11:1521403009:0.male: But warriors serve the god too, right? My dad's hunting party always brings the best game as an offering.
say:11:1521403009:0.female: But warriors serve the goddess too, right? My dad's hunting party always brings the best game as an offering.

say:12:1521403010:0.text: I dunno... But my mom said if I don't get picked, I shouldn't come home.
say:12:1521403010:0.source_cn: 那就不知道了……反正我阿娘说我要是选不上祭品，就别再回家了。

say:13:1521403011:1.text: If that happens... can I stay at your place?
say:13:1521403011:1.source_cn: 到时候，我能去你们家里住吗？
